bayts.text: And lead to him from my life what surpasses the wishes, and with You make me the joy of the trustworthy.
O our Lord, bless with a blessing encompassing all the blessings, perfect,
with a peace that never ceases to grow, protecting my sides from what harms me,
upon Your intimate, the beloved, Your servant, our Aḥmad, the Chosen, the light of Your host,
upon his Family and his Companions; and make all my service a good pleasure that is fulfilled.
O our Lord, bless with a blessing gathering every blessing, suppressing whoever possesses oppression,
with a peace whose growth is not cut off, upon him through whom harm to me is cut off.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And raise to You all the blessings of today, and keep me far from enemies and blame.
O our Lord, bless with a blessing that comes between me and roaming turbidities,
with a peace that draws to me what I love, removing toward others than us what we do not love,
upon my means of access to You, Aḥmad, the Family and the Companions; and make my life praiseworthy.
O our Lord, bless with a blessing that takes away every harm, with a peace that brings
to us happiness, gain and abundance, O Enricher Who has been for me with plenty,
upon him through whom You lead the aim to me, without enemies, or harm, or sickness.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
O our Lord, O You Who are exalted above slumber, bless on my behalf every month and year,
with Your peace, him whose intercession is accepted, him who led to me what puts every cannon to shame.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And write for him, in all that has issued from me of services, a sweetness without turbidity.
And make my blessing and my peace the best worship for You, that makes provisions clear.
And make my life a worship that lasts for him, glad tidings that put the servant forward.
And raise to Your Throne and the Footstool this poem of mine, by Your most holy Name.
O Allah, O One (Al-Aḥad), You are the Eternal Refuge (Aṣ-Ṣamad), O Raiser of the heaven without pillars (Qurʾān 13:2),
bless, by the right of "Say: He, Allah, is One" (Qurʾān 112:1), my means of access, Your unique Prophet.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant him, O Lord, from the day of Sunday, the highest glad tidings with everyone.
And make my writing for him privileges and sustenance, and an adornment that belittles the ruby.
O our Lord, bless with a blessing with peace him who effaced toil and blame,
and led me to You, O Lord, through You, and You led me through You to him, with Your love.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant him, O Lord, on Monday, what surpasses the wishes and needs, from two Bestowers,
without affliction and without turbidity, O You Who spared me the turbidities of decree.
